mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses equity discount rates through reduced risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained accommodative policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% with a 0.2pp monthly increase signals deteriorating labor market conditions that depress corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE rise > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days through improved earnings visibility.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods with both HOUST and RSAFS rising, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) combined with low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates stable price expectations and accommodative policy, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as recession risks diminish.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of regime periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals strengthening manufacturing activity and economic momentum, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days through improved corporate capital expenditure outlooks.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of INDPRO above moving average periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 500.0 (thousand units) signals a robust housing market that boosts consumer confidence and retail spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days via improved consumer sector performance.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of HOUST > 500.0 instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) with accelerating job losses (UNRATE rise > 0.1pp in 3 months) indicates deepening economic distress, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as recession risks materialize.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE rise > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals a recessionary policy response, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days as earnings deterioration accelerates.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of interaction periods, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.
